parameters.content:
## Workflow Trigger
You can replace this manual trigger with another trigger type as required by your use case.
## Send Request to OpenAI TTS API

### Input

Set input_text to at most 4096 characters and voice to a supported tts-1 voice, initially alloy. Keep your OpenAI key in the credential. The text is sent to OpenAI for speech generation.

### Output and availability

The HTTP node returns an MP3 in binary field data. No automatic retries are configured. Disclose that the recording is AI-generated when sharing it. OpenAI has announced tts-1 shutdown on 2027-01-06; plan migration before then. https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text-to-speech
